description.en: Aichi Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshū. Aichi Prefecture has a population of 7,461,111 and a geographic area of 5,172.92 square kilometres with a population density of 1,442 inhabitants per square kilometre .
